name: Blackberry Mountain
insider_take: Blackberry Mountain isn't just a luxury resort—it's a 5,200-acre wilderness playground where Relais & Châteaux elegance meets authentic Appalachian adventure in the shadow of the Great Smoky Mountains.
whats_special: This all-inclusive mountain sanctuary sits on a working farm that's been in the same family for over 200 years. The property features its own trout streams, miles of hiking trails, and a working blacksmith shop where guests can forge their own souvenirs. The resort's farm-to-table dining program sources ingredients from their own gardens and neighboring Blackberry Farm.
pro_tip: Book the sunrise hot air balloon experience—you'll float over the Smoky Mountains with views that stretch across three states, and it's one of the few places in Tennessee offering this aerial adventure.
dont_miss: The resort's signature "Mountain Moments" include moonshine tastings with local distillers, guided fly-fishing on pristine mountain streams, and stargazing sessions from their high-altitude observatory. The Great Smoky Mountains National Park entrance is just 15 minutes away, offering access to over 800 miles of hiking trails.
pros: Stunning Great Smoky Mountains location with breathtaking wilderness views
Exceptional outdoor adventure activities including hiking, fly fishing, and mountain biking
Luxurious wellness facilities with world-class spa and fitness amenities
Farm-to-table dining with locally sourced ingredients and craft beverages
cons: Remote mountain location requires travel planning
Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive experience
